protocols.title: Clear Skin & Hyperpigmentation Protocol (AM / PM Split)
protocols.conflict_alert: ACTIVE GUARDRAIL: Blocks layering leave-on AHA/BHA or harsh exfoliating bars (like twnskn 2-in-1 Bar) in the PM window with 0.1% Adapalene retinoid.
steps: AM Step 1: Lukewarm rinse or gentle non-stripping cleanser (60-second rule).
AM Step 2: Azelaic Acid 10% + Niacinamide 5% serum to fade dark spots without UV sensitivity.
AM Step 3: Broad-spectrum SPF 50 (mandatory — UV exposure undoes 4 weeks of dark-spot fading in 2 hours).
PM Step 1: Double cleanse (micellar/oil -> gentle ceramide wash) to remove sunscreen and NYC street pollution.
PM Step 2: Pea-sized 0.1% Adapalene on dry skin (wait 10 mins after washing to cut irritation by 60%).
PM Step 3: Ceramide barrier moisturizer + 250mg oral Apolactoferrin (linked to Wishlist wl_08).

protocols.title: Crash-Free Morning Energy & Deep Focus Stack
protocols.snapshot_status: Archived Local Snapshot (Original X thread deleted by author)
protocols.conflict_alert: CAFFEINE CUTOFF GUARDRAIL: Zero caffeine or pre-workout after 2:00 PM to prevent deep-sleep fragmentation.
steps: 07:00 AM (Upon Waking): 500ml water + pinch of electrolytes + 10 mins natural outdoor light before looking at phone.
08:30 AM (90-Min Delay): Delay first coffee/espresso 90 minutes after waking so morning adenosine clears naturally (eliminates 3 PM crash).
08:35 AM (Focus Pairing): Pair 100mg Caffeine with 200mg L-Theanine (2:1 ratio) to smooth jitteriness during deep coding or AZ-104 study blocks.
01:30 PM (Post-Lunch Walk): 10-minute brisk walk after lunch to flatten post-meal glucose spike instead of reaching for a second energy drink.
